biggest_catch: You must be 40-75 with no history of cardiovascular disease and must pass a pre-screening form; not everyone qualifies.
catches: Men and women ages 40-75 with no history of cardiovascular disease; pre-screening form required.
Vigorous exercise carries physical risk; sessions are supervised by researchers.

c1.evidence: Official UMass page: 'Three sessions will be conducted with compensation up to $450.'

c2.evidence: Official UMass page: 'The SITLess4Brain Lab is seeking participants for a short-term study to help researchers learn more about the relationship between sitting, physical activity and brain health.' Study is exercise-based, not cash for nothing.

c3.evidence: Official UMass page: 'Men and women ages 40-75 with no history of cardiovascular disease are eligible to apply for the study' and 'complete the pre-screening form'.

c4.evidence: Official UMass page: 'Three sessions will be conducted'. Exercise test plus exercise sessions supervised by researchers.

eligibility: Men and women ages 40-75 with no history of cardiovascular disease. Pre-screening form at redcap.link/hiit2sitless required. Contact: 413-545-8979 or sitless4brain@umass.edu. Study led by Dominika Pindus, assistant professor of kinesiology; supported by the National Institute on Aging.
notes: Announcement crawled 5 hours before capture; presented as currently recruiting.
numeric_basis: 3 lab sessions on official umass.edu page; page describes supervised exercise tests and 30-minute exercise intervals but does NOT publish total session duration - each session conservatively estimated at 2-3h: 3 x 2h = 360 min low, 3 x 3h = 540 min high, plus ~1h (60 min) prescreening form process; visit durations are estimates, not published
payout_quote: Three sessions will be conducted with compensation up to $450.
payout_value_note: Up to $450 across the three sessions.

s1.note: Amount is study-specific and concrete (up to $450) on official umass.edu domain.

s2.note: No upfront fee of any kind.

s3.note: Catches disclosed: eligibility/prescreening, exercise risk, 'up to' framing.

s5.note: One route anchors one specific study; no duplicate provider in catalog or evidence files.

s6.note: Page presented as current; session durations estimated from described protocol.

s7.note: UMass Amherst School of Public Health & Health Sciences; named researcher and NIH/NIA support.

steps: Complete the pre-screening form at the REDCap link on the official announcement.
The SITLess4Brain Lab contacts you if you meet the criteria.
Complete a supervised exercise test by an exercise physiologist.
Complete the remaining exercise sessions supervised by researchers.
Receive compensation of up to $450 across the three sessions.
timing: Three sessions; each involves supervised exercise on a stationary bike with rest intervals.
